rows.text: In connection with the creation of the Commonwealth of Independent States, the President of the RSFSR decrees that the Committee for Operational Management of the National Economy of the USSR be abolished ('Упразднить') and that the activity of the Interstate Economic Committee on RSFSR territory cease, its apparatus and structures on RSFSR territory passing to the RSFSR Government; signed 'Президент РСФСР Б.Ельцин', Moscow, Kremlin, 19 December 1991, No. 299.
